title: Probe state.json
description: The snapshot a probe-capable game rewrites about twice a second (docs/PROBE_CONTRACT.md). The core fields are required; everything else is optional, and games may add their own top-level fields.

wallTimeMs.description: Unix time in milliseconds when this snapshot was written

screen.description: The screen on show, as an upper-case name (TITLE, MAIN_MENU, WORLD, PAUSE, ...)

world.description: Whether a world (a game in play) exists; the world fields below are required when true

tps.description: Measured simulation ticks per wall-clock second

tick.description: Simulation ticks since the world began (saved with it)

yawDeg.description: Heading in degrees; which way it grows is the profile's movement.yaw_increases

speed.description: Walking speed in world units a second

nearest.description: Kind -> things of that kind, closest first

bearing.description: Degrees from where the player faces, + to the right
